newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Analysts' comments on Fortis Q1 results. [CORRECTED 11:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Analysts' comments on Fortis Q1 results. [CORRECTED 11:35 GMT]

text.p: Dutch-Belgian financial group Fortis reported an increase in net profits of 30 percent to 204 million ECUs for the first quarter of 1997.
Earnings per share of parent companies Fortis Amev and Fortis AG increased by 31 and 30 percent respectively.
The group also said it expected earnings per share to rise by between 10 and 15 percent in full-year 1997.
Below are a collection of analysts' comments.
BART VAN DER FEEN of Rabo Securities:

"The results were better than expected and for this reason we are upgrading the full-year forecast of Fortis Amev earnings per share to 5.10 guilders from 5.00 guilders. The cost control in the banking sector seems to be working and, as result, the banking unit VSB is doing better after a few meagre years. The result in the United States (from accident and health) was better than expected and the insurance result in Belgium was somewhat disappointing, but this is only temporary. The quality of the results is very good. The stock should be qualified as a strong buy."
DENNIS EDERZEEL of Delta Lloyd Bank:

"The recently acquired MeesPierson contributed substantially to the group's profits, probably for half of the 30 percent increase in Fortis' rise in net profits. The increase in turnover in life and non-life insurance activities was somewhat disappointing, but the banking sector did very well. Also Dutch banking unit VSB showed a good performance. For 1997 as a whole we upgrade our estimates for Dutch parent company Fortis Amev to 5.34 guilders per share from 5.17 guilders." (Corrects figures)
TON GIETMAN of Van Meer James Capel:

"We upgrade the earnings per share forcast for the group to 5.10 guilders per share from 4.90 guilders per share. The results of the group were better than expected and this was because the banking sector as a whole did so well. The acquisition of MeesPierson was a good thing for the company."

"It was much stronger than my estimate of 182 million ECUs. It's substantially better, and my estimate wasn't that pessimistic. All in all, the banking result surprised me the most, whereas insurance was only slightly better than my estimate. The ASLK life result came out lower than a year ago. That's a bit of a surprise. Given the fact that my insurance forecast was slightly lower than it came out, it means the other insurance businesses did quite well. I had a buy recommendation on Fortis and I will maintain that."
